query: Build a packing plan for my upcoming trip. The important weather info is in `INPUTS["trip_brief"]`. Make sure to delegate each city to child agents.

inputs.trip_brief:
Trip brief for structured extraction.

Seattle leg:
- City: Seattle
- Forecast condition: rain
- Forecast high: 60.0 F

Austin leg:
- City: Austin
- Forecast condition: sun
- Forecast high: 96.0 F

Denver leg:
- City: Denver
- Forecast condition: clouds
- Forecast high: 72.0 F

CityForecast.description: Forecast facts for one city extracted from the trip brief.
CityForecast.title: CityForecast

output_schema.description: Packing plan synthesized from the structured city forecasts.
output_schema.title: PackingPlan
